subsystems.name: Meander detector
subsystems.role: absorbs a single photon and converts it into a measurable voltage pulse.
parts: ultrathin superconducting film (niobium nitride or tungsten silicide)

subsystems.name: Cryogenic stage
subsystems.role: cools the detector well below its superconducting critical temperature.
parts: dilution refrigerator or helium-3 sorption cooler

subsystems.name: Bias and readout
subsystems.role: supplies a current just below the critical value and amplifies the tiny pulse.

subsystems.name: Optical interface
subsystems.role: couples photons from a fiber or waveguide to the nanowire.

subsystems.name: Photonic integrated circuit (optional)
subsystems.role: for chip-scale systems, the detector is evanescently coupled to a waveguide.

buildSteps.title: Deposit the superconducting film
buildSteps.detail: Sputter or atomic-layer-deposit a few-nanometre-thick film of niobium nitride or amorphous tungsten silicide onto a clean substrate such as silicon with thermal oxide, or sapphire.

buildSteps.title: Pattern the meander
buildSteps.detail: Use electron-beam lithography to define a long, narrow meander line roughly 50–150 nm wide covering a small area, then transfer the pattern by reactive-ion etching.

buildSteps.title: Add electrical contacts
buildSteps.detail: Deposit metal pads and leads, typically gold, for wire bonding to the readout circuit.

buildSteps.title: Package and align the fiber
buildSteps.detail: Mount the chip in a package and position a single-mode fiber so its core faces the meander, often with an anti-reflection coating or a cavity to boost absorption.

buildSteps.title: Mount on a cryogenic stage
buildSteps.detail: Attach the package to the cold plate of a dilution refrigerator or sorption cooler and connect filtered electrical lines.

buildSteps.title: Characterize performance
buildSteps.detail: Measure the critical current, then system detection efficiency, dark-count rate and timing jitter at telecom wavelengths.

buildSteps.title: Integrate with photonics (for waveguide detectors)
buildSteps.detail: Fabricate waveguides and evanescent couplers on the same chip, then dice and package the photonic circuit.

prerequisites.why: the detector relies on a material that loses all resistance below a critical temperature.
meander features are tens of nanometres wide, requiring electron-beam lithography and precise etching.
operation at a few kelvin needs dilution refrigerators or helium-3 sorption coolers.
the signal is a millivolt-scale pulse that must be amplified without adding noise.
waveguide-coupled detectors are demonstrated but not yet standard in all systems.

pathway.milestone: SNSPDs are the workhorse for quantum key distribution and photonic quantum computing experiments.
pathway.unlocks: secure communication and small-scale quantum photonic processors.

pathway.milestone: larger arrays and on-chip integration with silicon photonics.
pathway.unlocks: multi-photon experiments, quantum repeaters and compact quantum devices.

pathway.milestone: broadband, polarization-insensitive detectors and imaging arrays.
pathway.unlocks: astronomical observation, dark-matter searches and advanced quantum networks.
